# tmux / style-fuzzer

tmux's own fuzz target `style-fuzzer` ([source](source/style-fuzzer.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over tmux (tmux/tmux at f763f945).

style_parse on the NUL-terminated input (<=512 bytes) into a zeroed style/grid_cell; the return code and result are ignored.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against tmux at commit f763f945.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Statements ([Statements.v](Statements.v))

**Some statements are blocked by the model.** On the inputs they cover, the binary uses epoll or eventfd and creates pipes, which this release's model does not decode, so the statements marked "blocked by the model" are false in this model for that reason alone. The program is not at fault.
